text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to onboard orchid-lite v1.0.0 to the model catalog tomorrow. Non-incident deploy, looking for a deploy owner and a quiet-window that works for infra + QA.

josh: I can own the deploy. Prefer a 09:30 PT quiet window. I’ll run smoke + basic quant sanity.

maria: @josh that works. Also need a quick schema review for the catalog entry — PR #4823 is ready for review (adds metadata fields + pin).

lee: I’m on-call that slot and can monitor infra/alerts. Please post the rollout plan and rollback steps here so I can be ready.

josh: Rollout plan -> canary 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full if metrics look good.

Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) run local smoke: ./scripts/smoke_orchid.sh
2) sanity prompts against staging alias: orchid-lite:stg
3) tail runtime logs: kubectl logs -l app=orchid-lite -f --tail=200
4) verify embedding dims = 768 (embeddings API)
```

sam: QA note — Tina will run the functional smoke cases. @tina can you confirm availability?

tina: Confirmed. I’ll run 20 prompt cases (basic QA + regression targets) and post results here. ETA 20m after canary starts.

josh: Rollback plan (emergency): revert catalog pin and migrate traffic back to previous alias: `redwoodctl catalog swap --from orchid-lite --to nebula-4b --force`. I also have a patch ready to scale down replicas if needed.

lee: I’ll add a temporary alert rule: p95 latency > 400ms OR error_rate > 1% -> page oncall. Will post the rule ID once created.

deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled: catalog-pin/orchid-lite v1.0.0 at 2026-04-05T16:30:00Z. CI: ✅ all checks passed. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/6789

maria: Final checklist before go/no-go: PR review ✅, deploy owner @josh ✅, QA @tina ✅, oncall @lee ✅. I’ll post final thumbs-up 15m before the window.

tina: Smoke results (posting after canary): ran 20 cases — 20/20 pass, one minor tokenization diff on a corner prompt but no functional regression. :thumbsup:

josh: Starting canary now (10%). I’ll update with metrics.

josh: Canary 10% complete -> p95 210ms, errors 0.2%. Promoting to 50%.

lee: Monitoring looks healthy from infra side, no alerts so far.

josh: Promoted to 100%. Closing loop. @maria can you update the model-catalog docs with the pinned version and release notes?

maria: Will update docs and add release notes in the catalog repo. Thanks everyone — great coordination :tada:
